The modules' own parity gate stays tools/parity/weekly_books_goldens.py -> rust/crates/baskfy-desk/fixtures/weekly_books/goldens.json (41 cases: Python's answers, byte for byte, `cargo test -p baskfy-desk weekly_books::parity`), plus tests/weekly_books_reconcile.rs (test_reconcile.py whole, over the sleeves' real handlers and gateways). These cases grade the routes that render the lane's books over the replay Kite's default fixture: /reconcile and /reconcile/data (main.py:796/823 — reconcile_view.build over the broker's orders, GTTs and holdings, before and after a plan exists) and /performance (main.py:1124, whose `h` block is holdings_view over Kite.holdings). The routes are registered by the lanes that own them (wave D2: lane session ports /reconcile*, lane analytics_views /performance*); until they land these cases are DIFF (404 in Rust), recorded, not masked.
